title: Replace fixed 50ms Future.delayed polling with stream.first awaits in epic_15's curriculum-scope watch-stream test
why: 'scope watch stream emits on every change for provider reactivity' uses a fixed 50ms sleep 4 times as a stand-in for 'the stream has emitted by now', when the same test group already shows the deterministic alternative 100 lines earlier ('watchScopes emits updates when scopes change', lines 3439-3462, uses `await stream.first`). A timed sleep is a generic flakiness anti-pattern (no upper bound is ever truly safe under load) even though the practical risk here is low since the stream is backed by an in-memory NativeDatabase.memory() with no real I/O latency.
recommendation: Replace the 4 Future.delayed calls with `await emissions stream.first` / a captured StreamQueue read, consistent with the pattern already used at lines 3446 and 3459 in the same test group.
acceptance_criteria: The test contains no Future.delayed/sleep-based synchronization; each emission is awaited directly from the stream.
Test still asserts the same 4 transitions (initial empty, set, change, clear).
